title: Chris Titus WinUtil (Optimization Tool)
description: Chris Titus Tech open-source utility for quick Windows adjustments, essential tweaks, and system configurations

title: Scan & Repair System Files (SFC /scannow)
description: Scans and repairs corrupted or missing Windows protected system files using System File Checker

title: Repair Windows Image (DISM RestoreHealth)
description: Scans and repairs corruption in the Windows Component Store (WinSxS) using DISM

title: Complete System Repair (DISM + SFC Combo)
description: Executes DISM RestoreHealth followed by SFC /scannow for in-depth system verification and repair

title: Check Disk Integrity (CHKDSK C:)
description: Performs a read-only scan for logical file system errors on volume C:

title: Fix Network Printer RPC Error (0x11b / 0x709)
description: Adjusts RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled in Spooler to restore network printer sharing after Windows updates
command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Print" /v RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && net stop Spooler && net start Spooler

title: Fix Dual Boot Windows Clock (UTC / Linux)
description: Configures Windows hardware clock to UTC (RealTimeIsUniversal) to prevent time desynchronization with Linux

title: Repair & Reset Microsoft Store (wsreset -i)
description: Reinstalls and resets corrupted Microsoft Store components, registrations, and cache

title: Repair & Re-register WinGet (Package Manager)
description: Re-registers Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller package to restore the winget package manager CLI
command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'Re-registering Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller (WinGet)...'; Add-AppxPackage -RegisterByFamilyName -MainPackage Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_8wekyb3d8bbwe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Verification:'; winget --version"

title: Reset & Repair Windows Update
description: Stops update services, clears SoftwareDistribution and Catroot2 caches, and restarts update engine
command: net stop wuauserv && net stop cryptSvc && net stop bits && net stop msiserver && ren "%windir%\SoftwareDistribution" SoftwareDistribution.old 2>nul && ren "%windir%\System32\catroot2" catroot2.old 2>nul && net start msiserver && net start bits && net start cryptSvc && net start wuauserv

title: Flush DNS Resolver Cache (ipconfig /flushdns)
description: Clears local DNS resolver cache to fix domain resolution errors and outdated DNS records

title: Reset Winsock Catalog & TCP/IP Stack
description: Resets Winsock catalog and TCP/IP stack to default state to resolve broken network sockets
command: netsh winsock reset && netsh int ip reset

title: Complete Network & DHCP Reset
description: Releases and renews DHCP lease, flushes DNS cache, and resets Winsock and IP configurations
command: ipconfig /release && ipconfig /flushdns && ipconfig /renew && netsh winsock reset

title: List Open TCP Listening Ports
description: Queries and lists all active TCP listening ports and their associated process IDs
command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize"

title: Disable Windows Consumer Features & Suggestions
description: Disables automatic installation of sponsored consumer apps, OEM promotions, and cloud suggestions

title: Disable Windows Delivery Optimization
description: Prevents Windows Update from uploading update files to other PCs over the internet (P2P)

title: Disable BitLocker Encryption (C: Drive)
description: Queries BitLocker status and disables drive encryption on volume C: via manage-bde

title: Enable 'End Task' on Taskbar Right-Click
description: Enables developer quick 'End Task' option in the taskbar context menu for unresponsive apps

title: Disable Hibernation (Reclaim hiberfil.sys Space)
description: Disables system hibernation via powercfg to instantly reclaim disk space equal to RAM size

title: Disable Full Windows Telemetry & Diagnostics
description: Sets diagnostic data collection to Security/Basic and disables telemetry diagnostic logging
command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v MaxTelemetryAllowed /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && sc config DiagTrack start= disabled && sc stop DiagTrack

title: Remove Taskbar Widgets (WebExperience)
description: Disables taskbar widgets feed and stops background WebExperience WebView processes
command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh" /v AllowNewsAndInterests /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v TaskbarDa /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

title: Disable WPBT Execution (BIOS/OEM Bloatware)
description: Disables Windows Platform Binary Table execution to prevent BIOS firmware from injecting software

title: Optimize Background Services & SvcHost Split Threshold
description: Sets non-critical background services to manual and increases SvcHost split threshold to reduce RAM usage
command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control" /v SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB /t REG_DWORD /d 3670016 /f && sc config WerSvc start= demand && sc config DPS start= demand

title: Disable User Activity History & Cloud Sync
description: Prevents Windows from recording timeline activities and syncing user history to cloud accounts
command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System" /v EnableActivityFeed /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System" /v PublishUserActivities /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System" /v UploadUserActivities /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

title: Disable Background Apps (Global Policy)
description: Restricts UWP and store apps from waking up, consuming CPU, and running in the background
command: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\BackgroundAccessApplications" /v GlobalUserDisabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy" /v LetAppsRunInBackground /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f

title: Disable Windows AI Features (Copilot & Recall)
description: Disables Windows Copilot, snapshot saving, and AI Recall telemetry policies
command: reg add "HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot" /v TurnOffWindowsCopilot /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot" /v TurnOffWindowsCopilot /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI" /v DisableAIDataAnalysis /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI" /v DisableAIDataAnalysis /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

title: Disable Automatic Storage Sense
description: Turns off automatic Storage Sense background file cleanup and deletion routines

title: Disable Reserved Storage (Reclaim 7-10 GB)
description: Disables Windows Update reserved disk space buffer to free up system storage

title: Debloat Brave Browser (Disable Crypto, VPN & AI)
description: Configures policies to disable Brave Rewards, Crypto Wallet, Brave VPN, and Leo AI
command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\BraveSoftware\Brave" /v BraveRewardsDisabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\BraveSoftware\Brave" /v BraveWalletDisabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\BraveSoftware\Brave" /v BraveVPNDisabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\BraveSoftware\Brave" /v BraveAIChatEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

title: Debloat Microsoft Edge (Disable Shopping, Telemetry & Popups)
description: Disables Edge shopping assistant, telemetry, sidebar promotions, and background pre-launching
command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v EdgeShoppingAssistantEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v DiagnosticData /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v HubsSidebarEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v StartupBoostEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

title: Optimize Visual Effects for Performance
description: Tunes Windows animations, smooth scrolling, and window effects for maximum responsiveness

title: Disable Bing Search in Windows Start Menu
description: Removes web search results and Cortana cloud queries from Start menu search
command: reg add "HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" /v DisableSearchBoxSuggestions /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f && reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search" /v BingSearchEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search" /v CortanaConsent /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

title: Disable Mouse Acceleration (1:1 Raw Input)
description: Disables mouse pointer acceleration curve for consistent 1:1 cursor movement
command: reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseSpeed /t REG_SZ /d "0" /f && reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold1 /t REG_SZ /d "0" /f && reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold2 /t REG_SZ /d "0" /f

title: Clean Temporary Files (%TEMP% & Temp)
description: Removes residual temporary files from %TEMP% and C:\Windows\Temp folders
command: cmd.exe /c "del /q /f /s \"%TEMP%\*.*\" 2>nul & del /q /f /s \"C:\Windows\Temp\*.*\" 2>nul & echo Temporary files cleanup finished!"

title: Clean Windows Update Download Cache
description: Stops wuauserv and bits, purges SoftwareDistribution\Download, and restarts update services
command: net stop wuauserv && net stop bits && cmd /c "rd /s /q \"%windir%\SoftwareDistribution\Download\" 2>nul & md \"%windir%\SoftwareDistribution\Download\" 2>nul" && net start wuauserv && net start bits

title: Disable Telemetry Services (DiagTrack / dmwappushservice)
description: Stops and disables DiagTrack and dmwappushservice background tracking services
command: sc config DiagTrack start= disabled && sc stop DiagTrack && sc config dmwappushservice start= disabled && sc stop dmwappushservice && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

title: Query System Compression State (CompactOS)
description: Checks if Windows operating system binaries are compressed via compact.exe

title: Compress Windows System Binaries (CompactOS)
description: Reduces Windows disk footprint by compressing OS binaries without sacrificing performance

title: Run System Performance Benchmark (WinSAT Formal)
description: Runs the complete Windows System Assessment Tool benchmark for CPU, memory, graphics, and storage

title: List Available Power Plans (PowerCfg)
description: Lists all installed power management schemes and highlights the currently active plan
